dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $ G $ be a graph and $ m,n\in \mathbb{N} $ . The graph $ G^{\frac{m}{n}} $ is defined to be the $ m $ -power of the $ n $ -subdivision of $ G $ . In other words, $ G^{\frac{m}{n}}=(G^{\frac{1}{n}})^m $ . Conjecture Let $ G $ be a graph with $ \Delta(G)\geq 2 $ . Then $ \chi(G^{\frac{3}{3}})\leq 2\Delta(G)+1 $ .
